features.name: 访客与登录
features.scope: 访客能浏览；结算时登录并保留门店、规格、购物车。
acceptance: authenticated checkout keeps cart digest

features.name: 首页与导航
features.scope: 首页/点餐/优惠/订单/我的五个真实入口；购物车不再冒充订单。
acceptance: every enabled navigation target is real

features.name: 门店与履约上下文
features.scope: 选择门店、自取/堂食；定位拒绝可手动选店；切店先预检再确认。
acceptance: switching store never silently deletes cart

features.name: 门店菜单与搜索
features.scope: 按门店、时段、渠道、价格版本返回菜单；支持分类和无结果。
acceptance: sold-out SKU cannot be added

features.name: 商品与套餐规格
features.scope: 必选组、可选组、替换项、加价、数量上限和过敏原信息。
acceptance: same normalized configuration merges; different configuration stays separate

features.name: 购物车
features.scope: 基于商品及规格稳定行键；增减删、失效项提示、切店重验。
acceptance: line quantity 1..9; decrement at 1 removes line

features.name: 优惠券
features.scope: 查看可用性和原因、草稿选择/确认/取消；变更购物车使券失效。
acceptance: threshold uses eligible goods only; one coupon at P0

features.name: 报价与确认订单
features.scope: 服务端报价、有时效、明细、备注、取餐时间；变价必须重新确认。
acceptance: client does not set payable amount

features.name: 支付与状态确认
features.scope: P0 模拟支付；真支付仅预留适配层；超时先查单，不直接判失败。
acceptance: one active intent per order; duplicate submit produces one order

features.name: 订单与取餐
features.scope: 真实订单列表、状态时间线、取餐码、取消未支付单、再次购买重验。
acceptance: pickup code appears only after verified payment and fulfillment acceptance

features.name: 数据化验收
features.scope: stable_id、fixture、业务事件、观测与证据清单；测试入口只在验证构建。
acceptance: production bundle rejects reset/seed/advance-time commands

features.name: 自适应与无障碍
features.scope: 单栏/双栏共享业务状态；触控44pt；动态字体、焦点与键盘回归。
acceptance: resize does not lose selections, cart or duplicate order submission

features.name: 外送与地址
features.scope: 地址簿、服务范围、起送额、配送费、预约时间；地址变化重新报价。
acceptance: outside delivery area prevents checkout

features.name: 会员与积分
features.scope: 会员码、权益、积分流水；完成订单入账，退款冲销。
acceptance: point entries are unique by orderId and entry type

features.name: 活动与运营配置
features.scope: 活动位、券、商品集合、时段、分群、发布审核、版本回滚。
acceptance: expired or invalid campaign has safe fallback

features.name: 收藏与复购
features.scope: 收藏商品、历史订单再来一单；下架与变价明确提示。
acceptance: reorder is fresh cart creation, not reuse of old amount

features.name: 售后与退款
features.scope: 申请、原因、审核、退款结果与进度；账务与履约状态分离。
acceptance: refund success is server-confirmed, not client animation

features.name: 通知与消息
features.scope: 订单通知、消息中心、深链；拒绝推送仍可查订单。
acceptance: deep link enforces order ownership

features.name: 评价与客服
features.scope: 完成单评价、常见问题、订单上下文客服。
acceptance: only owned completed order can be reviewed

features.name: 隐私与账号
features.scope: 同意记录、权限按需申请、注销/导出/隐私入口；日志脱敏。
acceptance: no precise address, phone, payment credentials in evidence

features.name: AI辅助选餐
features.scope: 预算/人数/偏好生成套餐建议；仅受约束工具查真实菜单，用户确认加购。
acceptance: model output cannot invent SKU/price, bypass allergens or pay

features.name: 付费会员与权益卡
features.scope: 周期权益与核销台账；首版不做自动续费和储值。
acceptance: entitlement grant and consume are idempotent

features.name: 早餐预约与团餐
features.scope: 预约容量、截止时间、多人预算；先单付款人，后考虑分账。
acceptance: cannot book unavailable time slot

features.name: 增长实验与推荐
features.scope: 规则推荐优先；实验分桶稳定、曝光去重、隐私最小化。
acceptance: same account and experiment revision keep assignment
